prompt_template:
Simplify the news article using only facts stated in the article. Output exactly this format and use ':' after every label:

Summary:
<2 to 4 concise sentences>

Aspects:
Event: <main event>
People: <mainly relevant people or Not stated>
Organization: <mainly relevant organizations or Not stated>
Date & Time: <relevant dates and times or Not stated>
Location: <relevant locations or Not stated>
Effects: <effects or Not stated>
Countermeasures: <actions taken to address the event or Not stated>

"Aspects:" is a section header only. Do not write information on the Aspects line. Use every label exactly once. Do not add, rename, remove, or repeat labels. Do not guess information not stated in the article.

Article:
{article}
